latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of gh-pipelinegate.

- Enables chaining of Green Helix tools into configurable pipelines.
- Supports step sequencing, with options to stop on error or continue on failure.
- REST API to run pipelines and list available tools.
- Tools supported: scan-text, scan-skill, check-scope, validate, diff, check-env, convert.
- Returns detailed results for each pipeline step.
